name: Talbiyah.ai
description: Talbiyah.ai is an online Islamic education platform connecting students with vetted, qualified teachers for live one-to-one lessons in Qur'an recitation and memorisation, Arabic language, and Islamic studies. Every lesson produces AI-generated notes, vocabulary, and homework automatically.
audience: Muslims and new Muslims of any age seeking Qur'an, Arabic, or Islamic studies education; parents booking lessons for children
offerings: One-to-one live video lessons in Qur'an with Understanding (tajwīd and meaning)
One-to-one live video lessons in Arabic Language
AI-generated lesson notes, vocabulary, and homework after every class
Free Qur'an reader with translation, tafsir, and audio recitation
Free du'a builder and Islamic learning tools
A guided course for new Muslims (Unshakeable Foundations)
